newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market closes down in summer lull.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market closes down in summer lull.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market slipped on Friday with investors' interest in the doldrums, traders said.
No big changes were expected early next week, although traders said some bargain hunters might try to raise volatility on some small caps, in a bid to move the market.
Three independent market indices lost some ground, with almost all blue chips closing flat or marginally down.
The VAB-RA all-share index shed 0.9 percent to 6,243.5 points and the BIG-OTC was 0.69 percent down at 4,489.33. The CAS-RQ closed 0.08 percent down at 989 points.
Losers outnumbered gainers by 192 by 179. Prices for 279 stocks did not move.

Two main oil refineries closed unchanged from the previous session. Arpechim stayed at 39,000 and Petromidia at 43,000. Petrobrazi, another refinery lost 400 lei to 45,600. Steel mill Sidex also finished flat at 23,500.
Cement maker Romcim ended 3,000 lei weaker to 117,000.
